Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    r = "ok"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.000\x"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.000\x"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat & "|" & ws.Range("A1").Text
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\used.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.000\x"
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "General"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.000\x"
        r = "deleted"
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\unused.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.000\x"
        r = "deleted"
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 3
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.00"
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 4
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "General"
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 5
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "m/d/yyyy"
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 6
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat ""
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat & "|" & ws.Range("A1").Text
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000 "
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000;"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "[Red]0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "[red]0.0000"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat 5
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "#,##0.0000"
        ws.Range("B1").NumberFormat = "#,##0.0000"
        wb.Worksheets.Add.Range("C1").NumberFormat = "#,##0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "#,##0.0000"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat & "|" & ws.Range("B1").NumberFormat & "|" & wb.Worksheets(1).Range("C1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\several.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Bold = True
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat & "|" & ws.Range("A1").Font.Bold
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.Styles.Add "S1"
        wb.Styles("S1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000"
        r = wb.Styles("S1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        ws.Protect
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.5
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.0000"
        wb.Protect Structure:=True
        wb.DeleteNumberFormat "0.0000"
        r = ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat
        Tried = CStr(r)
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
